steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8069/ and sign in with username 'admin' and password 'admin' (submit the login form). Then in Odoo, create a new customer contact named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville' (go to Contacts app, click New, fill the name and city, save). Verify the record saved and report the customer name and city shown on the saved record. Note: Odoo long-polls so the page is never network-idle - wait for concrete elements instead.

02-create: In Odoo, go to the Sales app and create a new quotation (RFQ) for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (the customer field is an autocomplete dropdown - type the name and actually click the matching option from the dropdown so it is properly selected). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue (again, the product field is an autocomplete - actually choose an option from the dropdown), with quantity 3. Let Odoo auto-fill the unit price from the product. Save the quotation. Then report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the unit price Odoo filled in on that line, and (c) the Untaxed Amount the quotation shows. Do not confirm the quotation yet - leave it as a draft quotation. Note: Odoo long-polls so the page is never network-idle - wait for concrete elements instead.

03-open: In Odoo, open the existing draft quotation with reference {{02-create.quotation_reference}} (customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer', currently one line: '{{02-create.product_name}}' qty 3). Add a SECOND order line with a DIFFERENT product (the product field is an autocomplete dropdown - actually click an option from the dropdown; do not reuse Desk Combination) with quantity 2. Let Odoo auto-fill the unit price. Save the quotation. Then report: (a) the product name of the new second line, (b) the new Untaxed Amount the quotation shows, and (c) the Total. Keep the quotation in draft - do not confirm it. Note: Odoo long-polls so the page is never network-idle - wait for concrete elements instead.
